# check_letsencrypt

> A Nagios/Icinga plugin for checking Let’s Encrypt certificate expiry.

The shell plugin can inspect local certificates under `/etc/letsencrypt/live` or query certificate information through `crt.sh`. It supports configurable warning and critical day thresholds and requires curl and bc for remote checks.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/check_letsencrypt): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/check_letsencrypt/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.
